exposure.needed: whether Windows pods get launched on instance types that are not in the VPC resource controller config

original.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 fixes a bug where Windows pods failed to launch when the instance type was not in the VPC resource controller config.

decision.reason: [ev-664e993932dd] gives only one condition for the bug: launching a Windows pod on an instance type that isn't in the VPC resource controller config. It names no Helm value, CRD field, flag or version range that a static predicate could test. Whether Windows pods actually get placed on such instance types is decided at runtime by scheduling. So the undecidable exposure, with a runtime-behavior-gap reason and that 'needed' text, matches the evidence: it is neither broader nor narrower.
